text: This report recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law at 1693, 1695 and 1705-1709 Weston Road and 10 Victoria Avenue East to permit a 43-storey mixed-use building, including a six-storey base building. The proposal would provide a total of 599 dwelling units, including 15 rental replacement units and six affordable rental housing units, and 473 square metres of commercial space at grade.

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend City of Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013 for the lands municipally known as 1693, 1695 and 1705-1709 Weston Road and 10 Victoria Avenue East substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment included as Attachment 5 to the report (June 16, 2025) from the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke York District. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make such stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required. 3. City Council delegate the approval and signing authority to the Executive Director, Development Review for agreements related to payments-in-lieu of bicycle parking under Article 900.8.10 Exception Number [x190] of Zoning By-law 569-2013, as amended, in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor. 4.
